en: Can't give up... Fein said the same... But... the outcome will not change. Accept it... Irene.
Until I see my sister, no, until I bring her back... I won't give up...
Dead (Male)
Even all the way out here... why...
Soldier
So you're the ones who did this...
And if we did, what of it, little girl?!
Get ready!
You are...
I am Diana, guardian of this sacred forest.
Only the chosen, those who have received a holy blessing, can find their way here. So you are one of the chosen...
I don't know... but I'm honored to meet you, Holy Mother...
What is your name?
Irene, come here.
Irene... you seem to hold a wonderful power.
That must be why the Angel watches over you like this.
You can tell? That there's an angel?
Yes...
I see... So it's true...
Um, Holy Mother... may I ask you something?
Is... is the Demon Stone here?
There is no use hiding it from you, I suppose.
As you suspect, the Demon Stone is here. It is a precious thing the Angel entrusted to my keeping.
So it's true... the legend...
Irene, as fellow wards of the Angel, let us drive away the evil that seeks to cover the world.
Yes...
You did this?!
...The Demon Stone has been stolen.
If it comes to that, the world will be destroyed.
Irene... please protect the world. And please be a help to the Angel...
Yes, Holy Mother... I understand.
How horrible...
Please, hang on.
Why... did this happen...
Fall of the Holy City
Sis...
Hm? You're... Irene?
That's right...
What are you doing in a place like this?
I should ask you that, Serenis... What are you doing?
That's none of your concern, Irene.
Sis, please come back to your senses... please...
Fein's been searching for you all this time too...
Fein, hm... There was such a man, wasn't there...
Why... Sis... don't say things like that...
Fein still, even now, always...
Loves me?
Ahahahaha... don't be ridiculous...
I forgot all about that man long ago...
Don't get in my way either. I'm busy.
You're... not my sister anymore...
Is that so? Then you're no sister of mine, either.
You're an eyesore... Die.
Serenis... did you really kill Fein?
It's a lie, right...?
Oh, Fein...
Yes, I killed him.
I had my assassins do it.
He was annoying, sniffing around behind my back. Hehehe.
How horrible...
You're not my sister anymore...
Yes, and I don't think of you as my sister either.
Now, you're an eyesore, so you die too.
He was annoying, sniffing around behind my back. Hehehe.
Irene...
Who's there?
It is I... Irene.
Grand Master?
It's been a long time, Grand Master. Have you been well?
Yes. I'm managing somehow with the mages who crossed over to Legrance.
Irene, I came to see you for one reason only. It concerns your sister, Serenis.
...About my sister...?
You see... after you saved me at the Grand Lodge, I remembered your resolve, your words that you would not give up, again and again, and I thought.
You still feel the same, don't you?
Yes, I haven't changed.
All I ever said was to accept reality, however painful... I told Fein the same...
But I came to realize that perhaps I was wrong...
Facing the facts is necessary. But doing nothing at all may well be a mistake...
It may be impossible, but unless we try, we can never truly know...
Grand Master...
No one knows whether Serenis can be saved... But don't give up. Keep going.
Yes. Thank you, Grand Master...
No, I am the one who should thank you... You are trying to save the world, after all... Build the future... Irene.
Irene...
Sis. Let's end this...
End what? Everything begins now.
The Demon Stones are all gathered...
Now my wish will come true...
Stop it, please!
Just stand there quietly and watch, Irene.
Sis?
Sis!
＄＄＄＄＄＄! Lend me your strength, right now I'm sure...!
With this... please!!
Aaah!!
Serenis Midboss
Sissy!!
Irene? You know... I... had an awful dream...
It's morning already... thank goodness...
Starting today, I'm Fein's wife...
I've... been waiting so long... for this day to come...
Sissy...
I'm so happy...
Serenis... Sissy!!!
The tower is collapsing! Irene, quickly, let's get down from here!
...Goodbye, Sissy...
I'm sorry...
Irene 3
Irene, did you find out anything?
...I met her. In Ecclesia.
Really?!
Yeah... It was definitely my sister. But...
How was she?
She was leading the Empire's... Grosain's army...
Is that true...? Why?
I don't know...
But Serenis isn't the sister she used to be... Her heart... was different.
...Even so, I have to see her.
Fein... even if you do... my sister...
I did something to her that can never be undone.
I intend to atone for it, whatever it takes...
...That's not true, Fein... It wasn't your fault... I couldn't do anything either...
What happened to Sissy and to Grandpa... I'm responsible too...
No... it was all my own foolishness...
Irene, I want you to live, and protect the tower and Zig's bloodline.
Please... that's all I ask...
Fein...
Are you Viper?
What's up, little lady? When you ask a guy's name, you oughta give yours first.
Never mind my name. Now, give back the Demon Stone. I won't let you use it for some evil scheme.
Hmph... big words. And if I say no?
I won't let you say that. Not with my magic around.
You're a magic-user, huh... Now that you mention it, you've got that look.
Fine... I ain't dumb enough to pick a fight with a magic-user.
It's just a favor I'm doing anyway... I'll hand it over nice and easy.
You're there, ain't ya? Angel.{n}
You want it, don't ya? Truth be told.
Commander
...What a creepy man.
I won't let you do anything more this cruel...
Hmph... a little girl...
I'll spill that blood of yours...
So it's you... I won't let you get away this time.
Girl... have we met somewhere...
No matter. Pour your blood upon my sword.
Why do you fight?
Hmph, that's none of your business.
Tucking your tail and running again? So much for that fancy name of yours, Viper.
I can't let a little lady get in the way of my last bit of fun.
Wrong. I came to defeat a devil.
Devils always say the same thing...
They just keep bragging about how strong they are...
I'm sick of hearing that stuff!
Agh...
Irene!!!
How cruel... You did this?
Wizard & Warlock
Magic Orb
Ngh... in a place like this...
Guild 1
Mob 1
Mob 2
It's been a long time, Master Reijiher. I was nearby, so I thought I'd drop in.
Reijiher
Fein... so you're safe.
I was worried, having heard bad rumors about you.
Bad rumors about me? What sort of story?
Reijiher
Yes... that you had been killed by a traitor's hand.
It's a fact that Warlocks of unknown origin have been working in the shadows lately.
So I feared the worst, but I'm glad the rumor was false...
No... the rumor isn't entirely false. It's true that I was attacked by the Black Mages.
If luck hadn't been on my side again and again, I would have died, just as the rumor says.
I see... And did you find out who those Warlocks are?
No, nothing certain... But I believe they're the Empire's agents...
I think they attacked me because they knew I was heading for the Grosain Empire...
To think mages still remained in the Empire... I must tell the other lodges of this.
Your survival is good news, but mages serving the Empire is very bad news indeed.
Sooner or later the Guild Masters will have to gather and confer...
Oh yes, Fein, the Elder was worried about you as well. When you reach Basel, call at the Grand Lodge.
Yes, I will.
Thank you for the valuable information. But there's no telling what will happen now. Take care.
